name: iu2u
description: Powers for coding agents backed by any fast decision model, local or hosted: a shell-command guard that never auto-allows, proof before claiming done, output trimming, skill hints, compaction guidance, and tools to weigh, rank, seek and lint

base_url.title: Decision model URL
base_url.description: Any server that answers POST /v1/systemone, local or hosted. The default is a local server on port 11435

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Bearer key for hosted servers; leave empty for a local one

guard.title: Guard shell commands
guard.description: Block or escalate risky shell commands before they run; never auto-allows

proof.title: Require proof before done
proof.description: Stop the agent from declaring work done without reporting checks it ran

trim.title: Trim long command output
trim.description: Hide irrelevant parts of long command output; the full output is saved to a file. Do not combine with another hook that redacts command output: only one rewrite is kept

compass.title: Skill hints
compass.description: Suggest the personal or project skill that fits each request

prune.title: Compaction guidance
prune.description: Tell compaction which steps to keep in detail and which to drop
